title: DAM-captured statement with resolved end-user identity and service account
event_type: Database activity monitoring (DAM) console — captured statement detail view

fields.label: Session context
fields.value: web-app session id b7f2-9c14, source app: billing-portal

callouts.explanation: This is all a native audit log would show by itself — a shared service account, not the individual who triggered the query, illustrating the attribution gap the surrounding text describes.
This is the field a purpose-built DAM tool (or explicit application-layer pass-through) restores that connection pooling and native audit logs otherwise lose entirely.

Session context ties the resolved identity back to a specific application session, giving the analyst a way to correlate the statement with a specific user action rather than just a shared connection.

note: Illustrative/conceptual mockup of a DAM vendor console statement-detail view; not a captured screenshot of any real vendor product.
